tokens.name: surface-canvas
tokens.usage: The node canvas ground, under the dot grid. Also the app frame behind docked panels.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Docked panels: toolbar, inspector, results table body, status strip.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Anything that floats over the canvas or a panel: nodes, popovers, menus, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas inside a panel: inputs, the grid column header row, pivot drop zones, code editors.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, list items and ghost buttons on any surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, step numbers, column types, panel labels. On every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: placeholders, null cells, disabled steps. 4.5:1 on every surface token and on brand-tint, in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between panels, rows and sections; the canvas dot grid. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, switches), idle wires and handles. Meets 3:1 on panel, raised and canvas.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary actions, selection outlines, active wires, links, the focus ring. Puddle teal.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for brand buttons.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, selected steps, selected grid columns, the selected tab. Brand text reads on it.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The viewer: the eye badge, the viewed node's ring, the Output node chip fill. Never for text on light grounds.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-ring
tokens.usage: Outline of the viewed node and the pinned node. Meets 3:1 on raised and canvas, unlike the accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text and icons on panel, raised and canvas (the Output label, the pinned marker).

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the Output node chip and the pinned results header. Accent-ink reads on it.

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: Rules that pass, successful export. Always paired with a check glyph and a word. Blue so it never relies on red versus green.

tokens.name: pass-tint
tokens.usage: Pass badge background. Pass text reads on it.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warn-severity rule failures, sample mode, soft limits. Paired with a triangle glyph.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Warn badge and banner background. Warn text reads on it.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: Fail-severity rules, broken steps, broken wires, errors, destructive buttons. Paired with a cross glyph.

tokens.name: fail-tint
tokens.usage: Fail badge, error banner and failing-cell background. Fail text reads on it.

tokens.name: on-fail
tokens.usage: Text on a solid fail fill (destructive button).

tokens.name: node-source
tokens.usage: Source node glyph and ports. Files, URLs, clipboard.

tokens.name: node-source-tint
tokens.usage: Source node glyph chip.

tokens.name: node-transform
tokens.usage: Transform node glyph and ports. Most nodes are this kind, so it takes the brand.

tokens.name: node-transform-tint
tokens.usage: Transform node glyph chip.

tokens.name: node-combine
tokens.usage: Join and Append node glyphs and ports.

tokens.name: node-combine-tint
tokens.usage: Join and Append node glyph chip.

tokens.name: node-check
tokens.usage: Check node glyph. Quality gates stay neutral so their pass, warn and fail badges carry the colour.

tokens.name: node-check-tint
tokens.usage: Check node glyph chip.

tokens.name: node-output
tokens.usage: Output node glyph and label.

tokens.name: node-output-tint
tokens.usage: Output node glyph chip.

tokens.name: wire
tokens.usage: Idle wire between nodes.

tokens.name: wire-active
tokens.usage: Wires into and out of the selected node.

tokens.name: wire-broken
tokens.usage: A wire whose schema no longer satisfies the node downstream. Drawn dashed as well.

tokens.name: canvas-dot
tokens.usage: Dots of the canvas grid.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The product name in the toolbar. Nowhere else.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Empty states, dialog titles, the project name when editing it.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel titles, node names, the inspector's node title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Trim spaces from the start and end of every value.
styles.usage: Default UI text: step labels, form text, menu items, descriptions.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, the selected step, emphasis inside body.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, badge text, quick-fix chips, tab labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section labels inside the inspector and pivot zones. Always uppercase.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Grid cells, schema lists, sample values. Tabular numerals are on by default in this face.

styles.name: data-strong
styles.usage: Column names in the grid header, pivot field chips, column references in step labels.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: SQL expression editor, custom SQL steps, rule predicates.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Row, column and step counts on nodes; the status strip; query timings.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and a count inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label; badge vertical padding; handle offset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default gap between controls in a row; node inner padding vertically; list item horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Node inner padding horizontally; inspector section padding; field gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between inspector sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; empty-state stack gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Canvas auto-layout gap between ranks of nodes (dagre ranksep is 4x this).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, type tags, field chips, grid selection.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, quick-fix chips, list items, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Nodes, popovers, menus, pivot drop zones, banners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the floating results window.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Ports (handles), switches, the eye badge.

tokens.name: shadow-node
tokens.usage: Nodes at rest on the canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A node being dragged; popovers, menus and the wire schema tooltip.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the pop-out results window.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, quick-fix chips, inline icon buttons in the step list.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Default buttons, inputs, selects, tabs.

tokens.name: size-toolbar
tokens.usage: Top toolbar height.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Data grid row height and step list row height.

tokens.name: size-grid-header
tokens.usage: Grid column header: name row, type row and quality bar.

tokens.name: size-node-width
tokens.usage: Collapsed node width. Expanded nodes keep the width and grow down.

tokens.name: size-inspector
tokens.usage: Default inspector width (resizable 280 to 480).

tokens.name: size-handle
tokens.usage: Diameter of a node port.

tokens.name: z-canvas-node
tokens.usage: Nodes above wires.

tokens.name: z-panel
tokens.usage: Docked panels above the canvas.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, wire schema tooltip.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.
